PLAN "12-Week Strength Program Phased Around Cycle and Flares"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "build total-body strength while managing symptoms"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Cycle-Aware Loading" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-Safe Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Strength Progression":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x35 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength Progression":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-Safe Full Body Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
    WEEK 3:

        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Volume":

      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Technique":

    WEEK 4:
